entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 18-08-2023 Heard Mr. N.K. Agrawal, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Sitamarhi P.S. Case No. 237 of 2019 registered under Sections 304(B)/34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 18.04.2019 by the informant, Sangita Devi.
The allegation in the First Information Report is that the lady married the petitioner in the year 2018 but was tortured for dowry and finally resulted into her death.

The petitioner was also accused of raping the same lady which resulted into Vaishali P.S. Case No.
352 of 2018 under Sections 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code that led to compromise followed by the marriage which ultimately resulted Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49794 of 2023(2)
dt.18-08-2023 into her death.
On merit, this Court is not inclined to extend him the privilege of bail.

sentences.text: However, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that he has suffered by being in custody since 1st of October 2021 (as stated in paragraph 21 of the petition) and as such the stage of Trial be ascertained.

In that view of the matter, let a report be called for from the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sitamarhi in connection with Sitamarhi P.S. Case No. 237 of 2019.
Put up this case after receipt of the report.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Jagdish/-
